propwash.rescue.msg.failsafe: Radio link lost – GPS rescue is flying home
propwash.rescue.msg.override: GPS rescue aborted: sticks taken over
propwash.rescue.msg.not_armed: GPS rescue: drone is not armed
propwash.rescue.msg.no_home: GPS rescue: no home point set
propwash.rescue.config.title: GPS rescue
propwash.rescue.config.altitude.tooltip: Minimum height above the home point for the return flight. The drone climbs to at least this height first.
propwash.rescue.config.speed.tooltip: Cruise speed on the way home. Weak drones automatically fly slower.
propwash.rescue.config.descent.tooltip: Descent speed when landing. The final touchdown is always slow.
propwash.rescue.config.obstacles.tooltip: Detect obstacles: climb ahead of terrain, fly out sideways from under tree canopies and overhangs, hold position when there is no way out.
propwash.rescue.config.clearance.tooltip: Distance the drone keeps from blocks. Larger is safer but finds narrow gaps less easily.
propwash.rescue.config.min_distance.tool: Closer than this, the drone flies straight to the home point without climbing and lands.
propwash.rescue.config.auto_land.tooltip: On: land at the home point and disarm. Off: hover above the home point until you take over.
propwash.rescue.config.stick_override.to: Rescue aborts as soon as you move roll or pitch past the threshold (only while the radio link is up).
propwash.rescue.config.override_threshol: Roll/pitch stick deflection that aborts the rescue.
propwash.rescue.home_mode.first_arm.tool: The home point is set when the drone is armed for the first time.
propwash.rescue.home_mode.every_arm.tool: The home point is set again every time the drone is armed.
propwash.rescue.home_mode.pilot.tooltip: The drone lands next to you, wherever it took off.
propwash.rescue.home_mode.manual.tooltip: Set the home point only with the key or a switch. Without one, the takeoff point is used.
propwash.rescue.failsafe.return_home.too: When the radio link is lost, the drone flies back to the home point on its own.
propwash.rescue.failsafe.drop.tooltip: When the radio link is lost, the flight controller failsafe takes over: short descent, then motors off.
propwash.rescue.msg.stuck: GPS rescue can't find a way – the drone hovers, take over
propwash.rescue.autonomous.started: “%s” flies to the home point on its own and lands there.
propwash.rescue.autonomous.landed: “%s” has landed, %s m from the home point.
propwash.rescue.autonomous.rule_off: GPS rescue without pilot is off in this world – the motors of “%s” stop.
propwash.rescue.autonomous.busy: Too many drones are flying home on their own right now – “%s” descends straight down.
propwash.rescue.autonomous.too_far: The home point is too far away – “%s” lands where it is.
propwash.rescue.autonomous.stuck: “%s” can't find a way home and lands where it is.
propwash.rescue.autonomous.timeout: “%s” has been flying on its own for %s minutes and lands where it is.
propwash.rescue.autonomous.land_now: “%s” is flying home on its own and now lands right where it is.
propwash.rescue.autonomous.status: “%s” is flying home on its own · %s m to go
gamerule.propwash.autonomous_rescue.desc: If the return to home (GPS rescue) is running when the pilot leaves – remote put away, flight stopped or game left – the drone keeps flying on its own and lands at the home point. The server only keeps the chunks around the drone loaded and never flies into unexplored terrain. Off: without a pilot the motors stop, as before.
